framings.label: Live military operations and blockade
framings.description: Reports tactical developments such as strikes, the naval blockade, the new land-route task force, vessels fired upon and mines, mostly in a factual, event-by-event style.

framings.label: Diplomacy and de-escalation tracks
framings.description: Presents talks, the Qatari plan for nuclear inspections, reopening the Strait of Hormuz, and international calls for restraint as a possible path out of the conflict.

framings.label: Domestic politics and midterm fallout
framings.description: Treats the war through U.S. electoral and intra-party dynamics, including the midterm results, GOP criticism, clashing advisers, and accountability for the president and Hegseth.

framings.label: Official US triumph and resolve
framings.description: Relays administration messaging that portrays the war as courageous and historic, stresses finishing the job, and cites progress and blockade effectiveness.

framings.label: Skeptical assessments of war outcomes
framings.description: Questions official claims by pointing to the nuclear-information bounty, reported US-Israeli failures, oil company profits, and escalation risk.
